_meta.method: Primary sites (bls.gov, bea.gov, federalreserve.gov, opm.gov, alfred/fraser.stlouisfed.org, wikipedia, archive.org) were all blocked from this environment (proxy 403 for curl; DNS failure for WebFetch). Every date below comes from WebSearch result extracts that quote or link those sites, or from secondary news/calendar sources. A bls.gov archive URL of the form empsit_MMDDYYYY / an ALFRED URL of the form release?rd=YYYY-MM-DD&rid=N, seen in a result list, is counted as evidence of that release date.

field_rules.dates: Only dates supported by at least one source found in this session. Never filled by rule.
field_rules.unsourcedCandidates: Dates recalled from model memory (not derived by rule) that NO source in this session confirmed. Do NOT treat as sourced. Provided only so a later pass can confirm or reject them; a backtest that uses them should mark them unverified.
field_rules.confidence: verified = two independent sources agree or a primary page was quoted in an extract; likely = one good source; unverified = none.
field_rules.times: All times America/New_York. NFP/CPI 08:30 unless noted; FOMC statement 14:00 and press conference 14:30 unless noted; PIO 08:30 unless noted (several 2025 PIO releases were 10:00).
